notes: Flagged unit 17 (s017 + s019 + s020 → whereunto) is the same three-morpheme fusion as NUM.36.3 and is retained on the same grounds (rules 22, 30, 23).
ʾim carries the when and the opening waw the And; both morphemes are written, so nothing is added here, in contrast to the fused And if of v.3 where only a waw stands.
Both apodosis connectives (then, so) rest on written waws under rule 14.
